```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
bfgenomedir <- here("species/bflo/VNyyK")
mmgenomedir <- here("species/mmus/genome/interaction")
orthdir <- here("orthofinder/results/2025-03-06")

resdir <- here(bfgenomedir, "results/interaction")
fs::dir_create(resdir)
```

# Data

## Ligand receptor data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

omnipath_lr <- read_tsv(here(mmgenomedir, "results/ligrecextra_mmus.tsv"))
omnipath_lr
```

## Genomic data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

mmgenes <- read_tsv(here(orthdir, "id-name-mapping/mmus.tsv")) %>% 
  select(gene_id, symbol) %>% 
  distinct()

orth <- read_tsv(here(orthdir, "pairwise-orthologs/mmus_vs_bflo.tsv")) %>% 
  left_join(mmgenes, by = c("mmus" = "gene_id"))
```

# We need to use HOGs instead of one:one orthologs

If we keep only one-to-one orthologs, we are left with only 47 source-target pairs. 

```{r}
omnipath_lr %>% 
  filter(source_genesymbol %in% orth$symbol[orth$type == "one.to.one"] &
           target_genesymbol %in% orth$symbol[orth$type == "one.to.one"]) %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

If we use all types of orthologs (by using HOGs instead of individual genes), we keep many more source target pairs.

```{r}
omnipath_lr %>% 
  filter(source_genesymbol %in% orth$symbol &
           target_genesymbol %in% orth$symbol)
```

# Define display names for HOGs

We will use mouse symbols as displays names for each HOG. 

```{r}
hogs <- orth %>% 
  group_by(hog) %>% 
  summarise(mmus = list(unique(mmus)),
            bflo = list(unique(bflo)),
            symbols = list(sort(unique(symbol)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(n_symbols = map_int(symbols, length)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_symbols))

hogs %>% 
  filter(n_symbols > 1)
```

```{r}
hogs %>% 
  filter(n_symbols > 1) %>% 
  pull(symbols) %>% 
  head()
```

```{r}
hogs$hog_name <- vector("character", nrow(hogs))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(hogs))) {
  hogs$hog_name[i] <- paste(
    hogs$hog[i],
    paste0("m", length(hogs$mmus[[i]])),
    paste0("b", length(hogs$bflo[[i]])),
    # use first and last symbol as examples
    paste(unique(c(head(hogs$symbols[[i]], 1),
                   tail(hogs$symbols[[i]], 1))), collapse = "."),
    sep = "."
  )
}


hogs %>% 
  slice(c(1:10, 11:20)) %>% 
  print(n = 20)
```

```{r}
hogs %>% 
  mutate(mmus = map_chr(mmus, paste, collapse = ";"),
         bflo = map_chr(bflo, paste, collapse = ";"),
         symbols = map_chr(symbols, paste, collapse = ";")) %>% 
  select(hog, hog_name, symbols, mmus, bflo) %>% 
  write_tsv(here(bfgenomedir, "results/orthofinder/HOGs_mmus-vs-bflo.tsv"))
```

# Prepapre ligand-receptor data using HOGs

```{r}
orth_lr <- orth %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% omnipath_lr$source_genesymbol | 
           symbol %in% omnipath_lr$target_genesymbol) %>% 
  select(hog) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(hogs, by = "hog")
```

```{r}
hog_symbol_mapping <- orth %>% 
  select(hog, symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(symbol))
```

```{r}
lr <- omnipath_lr %>% 
  filter(source_genesymbol %in% mmgenes$symbol &
           target_genesymbol %in% mmgenes$symbol) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("mechanism") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -mechanism, 
               names_to = c("direction", NA), 
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "symbol") %>% 
  left_join(mmgenes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  left_join(orth %>% 
              select(mmus, hog) %>% 
              distinct(),
            by = c("gene_id" = "mmus")) %>% 
  left_join(hogs %>% 
              select(hog, hog_name) %>% 
              distinct(),
            by = "hog") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = mechanism, 
              names_sep = "__", 
              names_from = direction,
              values_from = c(symbol, gene_id, hog, hog_name)) %>% 
  select(-mechanism) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hog__source) & !is.na(hog__target))
```

```{r}
apply(lr, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x)))
```


```{r}
lr_hogs <- lr %>% 
  select(hog_name__source, hog_name__target) %>% 
  distinct() 

lr_hogs
```

```{r}
write_tsv(lr_hogs, here(resdir, "omnipath_lr_mmus-to-bflo_hogs.tsv"))
write_tsv(lr, here(resdir, "omnipath_lr_mmus-to-bflo_symbols.tsv"))
```
